what: The real-arm bridge now runs as a headless service that starts automatically with the Unreal editor; drive (torque on) is switched from the Table 10 web panel instead of a terminal.
why: User request: no separate app to start; when UE starts the bridge starts, and the real arms are controlled from the web page or VR.
details: Service reuses real_arm_bridge.Bridge (engage match within 5 deg, 0.6 rad/s cap, jump rejection, verified return before torque off); starts in mirror.
Dead-man: drive needs a fresh heartbeat from the agent (which needs the web server); lost heartbeat, drive off or lost Unreal state returns the arms and releases torque. Drive auto-off after 15 min.
Drive can only be switched on from the tailnet, never from the public link; Torque off works for everyone. Public visitors are view-only unless they have the operator code.
